name: trade-bot-macd-uniswap
description: Watches a token's MACD (12/26/9) and, on a bullish cross below the zero line after a pullback, returns an unsigned UniswapV4 quote to buy the token with USDC, and on a bearish cross above zero returns an unsigned sell quote. It also replays the same rules over the fetched candles as a backtest, showing a balance time series and percent P&L.
